title: 5. How we know a repository reads well

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: The test is a person or a cold agent reading it, not a checker going green.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: Wave 5, Read as a human (9ff0a734): its exit criterion is a front-to-back read-through by someone who did not write it. The zero-context agent test (8b87b2d5) failed: no tree walk, one invented id (finding bbe9faf9). The lenses remedy (364126da) uses a person finding their way as its falsifier. The owner, 2026-10-29: a new agent should be able to start from any SemanticOps domain (fdc74e98). SP-116: a repository that takes minutes to open stops being used. Proposed in srs-rust#1490: a coverage report of what is not reachable from the root.

sections.name: principle
sections.label: Principle
sections.content: Read-through and reachability are the tests. Decided for Wave 5; reachability proposed.
